hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.rs) rustfmt --edition 2021 "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE '(CLAUDE\.md$|Cargo\.lock$|\.git/)' && echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Protected file"}' || true
